I thought the story of Dr Jekyll and Mr. Hyde was 100% true. My grandma told me about it briefly when I was about five, and she never explicitly said that it was just a story, so for the first ten years of my life I just assumed that there was a guy that tried to find a way to stop death and in the process, accidentally made himself turn in-between a Dr. and a murderous dickhead. It scared the fuck out of me for a long time... Until I actually thought about it when I was older and realized he wasn't real.
That if I ate watermelon seeds that they would grow in my stomach. So that is why I was told to spit them out.
That unbaptized babies, who died, went to a place called Limbo. I could go on an on but i'll leave it at that.
